post.title: Brands gave this grocer more than its profit
post.ig:
Brands gave this grocer more than its profit.
Ingles Markets, fiscal 2025: $151.9 million in vendor allowances (volume rebates, promo deals, ad money and slotting fees) versus $83.6 million in net income. Ingles doesn't disclose how much is slotting fees.
Slotting fees pay for shelf space for new products. The FTC found average slotting fees of $2,313 to $21,768 per item, per retailer, per metro area, depending on retailer and city (2003 report).
Ingles' profit: about 1.6 cents per dollar of sales ($83.6M on $5.33B).
Sources: Ingles Markets 10-K (fiscal 2025), FTC.
